is_logic_change.instructions: This pull request changes program behaviour. It is NOT only documentation, comments, formatting, renames, test-only changes, generated files, or dependency version bumps.

weakens_tests.instructions: This pull request weakens test coverage or strictness: it removes tests, adds skips (t.Skip, Pending, ginkgo.Skip, xfail), loosens assertions, raises timeouts, disables checks, or marks tests as flaky.

message_matches_diff.instructions: The pull request title and message accurately describe what the diff does. There are no undisclosed changes in the diff and no claims in the message that the diff does not implement.

touches_concurrency.instructions: The diff modifies code with concurrency hazards: locks, mutexes, goroutines, channels, wait groups, caches, retries with shared state, or other shared mutable state accessed from multiple goroutines.

needs_human_review.instructions: A careful maintainer of this repository would want a human to review this pull request before it merges, because it changes behaviour in a non-trivial way, touches risky code, weakens tests, or because its message does not fully explain the diff. Trivial, mechanical, documentation-only, or clearly safe changes do not need a human.
